rows.section: PIT scale (skala podatkowa, art. 27)
rows.basis: Taxable income (podstawa obliczenia podatku), per year
rows.note: Up to PLN 120,000: 12% minus the tax-reducing amount of PLN 3,600, so the first PLN 30,000 is effectively tax-free; above it, PLN 10,800 plus 32% of the excess. The same scale applies to employment income, contracts of mandate and business income taxed on the scale.

rows.value: None: the visa purposes in art. 60 of the Act on Foreigners include no remote-work purpose; foreign freelancers use a business visa and the temporary residence permit to run a business
